sm_top.sm: Oman rescues 25 sailors from a burning tanker in the Strait of Hormuz.
Israeli forces demolished the homes of Palestinians blamed for attacks in Hebron.
Jordan launched military strikes in Syria following a deadly church attack.
North Korea displays stealth-designed unmanned aircraft at its first UAV exhibition.
A U.S. official warned that Trump may order military action against Iran after the midterm elections, urging allies to prepare.
An oil tanker was struck by mines or an unidentified projectile in the Strait of Hormuz.
A drone strike on a market in Nyala resulted in varying casualty reports, ranging from dozens to over 100 deaths.
President Zelensky stated that delivery of 500 Patriot interceptor missiles approved by the US will take several years.
Jordanian authorities arrested suspects in connection with a deadly attack.
The Saudi-led coalition intercepted Houthi ballistic missiles and drones targeting Riyadh and other regions.
A Russian missile strike on Chernihiv killed two teenage girls.
Ukraine resumed strikes on Russian oil refineries, as reported by multiple sources.
Iran's Revolutionary Guards downed a US MQ-1 drone over the eastern Strait of Hormuz.
A container ship was struck and sunk by drones off the coast of Bulgaria in the Black Sea, forcing the crew to be rescued.
An Israeli strike in Gaza kills four Palestinians.
Casualties climbed following an Al-Shabaab attack on Somali army forces advancing near Burhakabo.
A Russian drone strike kills 14 people at the Dnipro train station.
Attacks targeting Ethiopian Orthodox Christians in Oromia resulted in at least 60 deaths, according to the church.
Russia stated the war must continue following a massive Ukrainian drone attack targeting Moscow.
A drone strike hit an IDP camp in Ethiopia, killing several people.
The UN Commission reported that Israeli forces committed war crimes and genocide even after the Gaza ceasefire.
Ethiopia took delivery of 12 Su-35 fighter jets and is set to receive S-400 air defense systems, PM Abiy announced.
The Saudi-led coalition intercepted a Houthi cruise missile.
Sudan alleged that drone strikes were launched against civilian power infrastructure from neighboring Ethiopia.
Russian air defense forces intercepted numerous Ukrainian drones over several regions.
The US and Israel are preparing a weeklong bombing campaign against Iran.
A Russian aerial bomb destroyed a five-story apartment building in Izium, causing casualties and trapping people under the rubble.
A cargo ship sank off the coast of Bulgaria in the Black Sea following a drone attack.
Russian drone and ballistic missile attacks on Ukraine leave one dead in Kyiv and damage infrastructure.
Yemeni Transport Minister denies Houthi claims regarding an attack on Aden Airport.
Iran claims the Strait of Hormuz is completely closed and warns that ships leaving the designated route will be damaged.
A drone attack hit an oil refinery in Ufa, Russia, causing a fire.
A Saudi airstrike killed 13 civilians in the besieged city of Taiz, Yemen, amid famine conditions.
Yemeni Transport Minister announced the resumption of operations at Aden Airport following earlier Houthi shelling.
Communal violence in South Sudan resulted in 84 deaths.
An oil tanker attack near Oman deepened the maritime crisis in the Strait of Hormuz.
An employee at the Zaporizhzhia Nuclear Power Plant was killed in a drone attack.
Rights groups report that strikes on a Darfur market in Sudan killed more than 100 people.
Russian forces launched 134 drones from six directions in an overnight attack across Ukraine.
Russian Ministry of Defence claimed air defense forces intercepted and destroyed 433 Ukrainian drones overnight across multiple regions.
